hypothesis: Persistent own-content witness plus signed cell offset distinguishes blank-slot histories through repeated resizes.
scope: Resize-only bursts after real picture intake. No shipping promotion. No writes/scrolls/placement mutation while state is live.
witness: Nearest non-whitespace glyph (not wide spacers) within old wrap chain, ties toward smaller old cell index. Preserve signed cell offset; never reacquire after collapse. Contentless chain uses persistent physical-only mode.
lifetime: Drop if selected witness is physically erased or derived final slot is outside retained grid. No resurrection. This is a selected-witness contract, not all possible logical-line contracts.
gates: unchanged previous marker and deletion matrices, continuous-in-bounds lens
right witness and negative offsets, wide spacer boundary, intervening write falsification
shipping: restore exact starting sources and executable
